# Pinned workflow-lint tooling for the Release tooling workflow and for local use:
#   pip install -r .github/requirements/workflows.txt
# actionlint-py is the actionlint binary in a wheel; shellcheck-py is ShellCheck
# in a wheel, which actionlint runs over every `run:` block when it is on PATH.
# Dependabot's pip ecosystem for /.github/requirements keeps this current.
actionlint-py==1.7.12.25
shellcheck-py==0.11.0.1
